entries.claim: At the DEFAULT fire-mode setting (DAT_0044d500 0, the global never stored) the original switches the fire mode on a double tap -- a second first press while the .25 s marker a first press sets is live (FIRE_MODE_DOUBLE_TAP_S_READING) -- or each time the button's held time passes .4 s (FIRE_MODE_HOLD_REPEAT_S_READING), zeroed at the switch; a short tap switches nothing. The take is the consumer's: a frame the player update does not reach it takes nothing, while a switch the weapon refuses has still consumed the tap. At ALTERNATE (FIREMODESWAP_CONTROLLER 1) it switches at the first press. A game state's start flushes the button (FUN_002dba60): its state read afresh, every tap marker -3, so a button held through it is no press and no double tap spans it. Both pages take it through the one lane (matchLanes.ts playerLanes: fireModeInputFor(l).step, research 254 s4; PAR-22's wave-4 hunk), the menu match reading the setting off its OPTIONS and /testroom DEFAULT, each page flushing the button with its lanes' read; research 230's inputTiming.test.ts single tap, double tap and held for 31 original ticks are ordinary tests.
